definition_en: a formal test of knowledge or ability
core_image: 桌上摊开的试卷和滴答作响的钟
scene: 最后一场考试结束，教室里的钟刚好指向四点。When the last exam ended, the clock in the classroom pointed exactly to four.
sceneCN: 这里 exam 是「考试」（第 1 个义项：对知识的正式测试）；句意：最后一场考试结束，教室里的钟刚好指向四点。

senses.title: A test
senses.definition: a formal test of knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 对知识的正式测试
senses.example: She passed the math exam.
senses.exampleCN: 她通过了数学考试。
senses.why: Exam is a short form of examination.
senses.whyCN: exam 是 examination 的缩略形式。

senses.title: A medical check
senses.definition: a medical examination
senses.definitionCN: 医学检查
senses.example: The doctor gave him a quick exam.
senses.exampleCN: 医生给他做了快速检查。
senses.why: The short form also covers medical checks.
senses.whyCN: 这个缩略形式也涵盖医学检查。

senses.title: A formal assessment
senses.definition: an official assessment of ability
senses.definitionCN: 对能力的正式评估
senses.example: The driving exam has two parts.
senses.exampleCN: 驾照考试分为两部分。
senses.why: Exams can test skills, not only knowledge.
senses.whyCN: 考试也能测试技能，而不只是知识。

intro.en: Exam shortens examination, from Latin examen, the tongue of a balance.
intro.cn: exam 是 examination 的缩写，源自拉丁语 examen（天平指针）。

items.en: Examen means the tongue of a balance.
items.cn: examen 意为天平的指针。

items.en: Examinare means to weigh or test.
items.cn: examinare 意为称量或检验。

items.en: French examen means an inquiry.
items.cn: 法语 examen 意为查问。

items.en: Examination names a formal test.
items.cn: examination 指正式测试。

items.en: Exam shortens the long word.
items.cn: exam 缩短了这个长词。

note.en: Exam is the everyday short word; examination is formal.
note.cn: exam 是日常短词；examination 更正式。

entries.definition: a set of questions or tasks
a judgment of ability or quality

normalIntro.en: Exam is the short word for the long day of testing.
normalIntro.cn: exam 是漫长考试日的短词。

normal.en: Take an exam means sit the test.
normal.cn: take an exam 意为参加考试。

normal.en: Pass an exam means succeed in it.
normal.cn: pass an exam 意为通过考试。

normal.en: Fail an exam means not reach the mark.
normal.cn: fail an exam 意为未达到及格线。

normal.en: A final exam comes at the end of a course.
normal.cn: final exam 是课程结束时的考试。

normal.en: Compare test: an exam is usually formal and long, a test can be short.
normal.cn: 对比 test：exam 通常正式且较长，test 可以很短。

abstract.en: Picture a paper on a desk and a ticking clock.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上的试卷与滴答的钟。

abstract.en: Imagine a scale weighing what you have learned.
abstract.cn: 想象一架天平称量你学到的东西。

abstract.en: Think of a door that opens only after a careful check.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇仔细检查后才打开的门。

examples.en: He has three exams next week.
examples.cn: 他下周有三场考试。

examples.en: The exam lasted two hours.
examples.cn: 考试持续了两个小时。

examples.en: She studied hard for the final exam.
examples.cn: 她为期末考试努力学习。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「exam」是 examination 的短装版——把长词剪短，考试还是考试。

root: 拉丁语 examen（天平指针，引申为检验）→ examination → exam。

sensesIntro.en: Exam names a formal test, a medical check, and any official assessment of ability.
sensesIntro.cn: exam 指正式考试、医学检查，以及任何对能力的正式评估。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a paper on a desk and a ticking clock.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌上的试卷与滴答作响的钟。

branches.en: A written test is the core sense.
branches.cn: 笔试是核心含义。

branches.en: A medical check uses the same word.
branches.cn: 医学检查使用同一个词。

branches.en: Any formal assessment counts.
branches.cn: 任何正式评估都算。

branches.en: Knowledge and health are both examined.
branches.cn: 知识与健康都受到检验。

branches.en: Papers and driving tests share one name.
branches.cn: 试卷与驾照考试共用一个名称。

intro.en: Exam is a shortened form of examination.
intro.cn: exam 是 examination 的缩短形式。

latinIntro.en: Latin examen, a balance tongue, gives the root idea of testing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 examen（天平指针）提供了检验的词根含义。

items.exampleCN: examiner 加上表示人的后缀。

latinEntries.example: Examen gives the idea of testing.
latinEntries.exampleCN: examen 提供检验的含义。

latinEntries.example: Examinare becomes English examine.
latinEntries.exampleCN: examinare 变成英语 examine。

definition_en: a formal test of knowledge, or a careful look at something
core_image: 考场上摊开的试卷和一支削好的铅笔
scene: 毕业考试的铃声响起，学生把准考证放在桌角。The final examination began as soon as the bell rang.
sceneCN: 这里 examination 是「考试」（第 1 个义项：对知识水平的正式测试）；句意：毕业考试的铃声响起，学生把准考证放在桌角。

senses.title: A formal test
senses.definition: a formal test of what someone knows
senses.definitionCN: 对某人知识水平的正式测试
senses.example: She passed the entrance examination.
senses.exampleCN: 她通过了入学考试。
senses.why: To examine someone's knowledge is to test it.
senses.whyCN: 考查某人的知识就是对其进行测试。

senses.title: A careful look
senses.definition: a close look at something to judge its state
senses.definitionCN: 为判断状况而仔细查看
senses.example: A medical examination found nothing wrong.
senses.exampleCN: 体检没有发现任何问题。
senses.why: The noun names the act of examining something closely.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指仔细检查某物的行为。

senses.title: A formal inquiry
senses.definition: an official process of asking questions
senses.definitionCN: 正式提问调查的过程
senses.example: The matter is still under examination.
senses.exampleCN: 此事仍在调查中。
senses.why: Questions put the facts on the scales.
senses.whyCN: 提问把事实放到天平上衡量。

intro.en: Examination comes from Latin examen, the tongue of a balance used for weighing.
intro.cn: examination 源自拉丁语 examen，即天平上用来称量的指针。

items.en: Examen means the tongue of a balance.
items.cn: examen 意为天平的指针。

items.en: Exigere, to weigh or drive out, is the source.
items.cn: exigere（称量、驱出）是其来源。

items.en: Old French examiner means to question closely.
items.cn: 古法语 examiner 意为仔细盘问。

items.en: English examination first means a careful inquiry.
items.cn: 英语 examination 最初指仔细调查。

items.en: It now also means a formal written test.
items.cn: 如今它也指正式的笔试。

note.en: Examination is the act or the test; examine is the verb behind it.
note.cn: examination 是行为或考试本身，examine 是背后的动词。

entries.definition: a short word for an examination
to look at or test something
a set of questions to measure knowledge

normalIntro.en: Examination is the weighing of knowledge.
normalIntro.cn: examination 是对知识的一次称量。

normal.en: An exam is a shorter word for examination.
normal.cn: exam 是 examination 的简短说法。

normal.en: An examiner sets and marks the examination.
normal.cn: examiner 出题并批改 examination。

normal.en: A medical examination checks the body.
normal.cn: medical examination 检查身体。

normal.en: Under examination means being studied or checked.
normal.cn: under examination 意为正在被检查。

normal.en: Examination paper is the paper you write on.
normal.cn: examination paper 是你作答的试卷。

abstract.en: Picture a balance with knowledge on one pan.
abstract.cn: 想象一架天平，一端放着知识。

abstract.en: Imagine a doctor reading a body like a map.
abstract.cn: 想象医生像读地图一样查看身体。

abstract.en: Think of a lamp shining into a dark box.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯照进黑暗的盒子。

examples.en: The final examination lasts two hours.
examples.cn: 期末考试持续两小时。

examples.en: A close examination revealed a small crack.
examples.cn: 仔细检查发现了一条小裂缝。

examples.en: The plan is still under examination.
examples.cn: 该计划仍在审查中。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「exam（考试）＋ ination」——把知识放到天平上称一称，就是考试与检查。

root: 拉丁语 examen（天平指针）→ 称量、考查 → 古法语 examiner → 英语 examination，核心义「把事物放上天平仔细称量」。

sensesIntro.en: Examination can be a formal test, a careful physical check, or an official inquiry.
sensesIntro.cn: examination 可以是正式考试、仔细检查，也可以是正式调查。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: knowledge weighed on a balance.
core.cn: 核心意象：知识被放上天平称量。

branches.en: The formal test puts learning on the scales.
branches.cn: 正式考试把所学放上天平。

branches.en: A careful look weighs the state of things.
branches.cn: 仔细检查衡量事物的状况。

branches.en: Questions drive out the hidden facts.
branches.cn: 提问把隐藏的事实找出来。

branches.en: Both the test and the check begin with weighing.
branches.cn: 考试与检查都从称量开始。

branches.en: Inspection turns into inquiry when questions are asked.
branches.cn: 一旦开始提问，检查就变成调查。

intro.en: Examination builds on examine, from Latin examen, a balance tongue.
intro.cn: examination 建立在 examine 之上，源自拉丁语 examen（天平指针）。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb exigere, to weigh or drive out, gives examen and then examine.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词 exigere（称量、驱出）先给出 examen，再给出 examine。

items.example: Ex- here suggests driving something out.
items.exampleCN: ex- 在此有把东西驱出的意味。

items.example: Agere appears in agent and agenda.
items.exampleCN: agere 出现在 agent 与 agenda 中。
exigere 由 ex- 与 agere 组成。

items.example: The suffix turns a verb into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 该后缀把动词变成名词。
它标记名词的完成形式。

latinEntries.example: Examen is the root of examination.
latinEntries.exampleCN: examen 是 examination 的词根。

definition_en: to look at something closely or test someone's knowledge
core_image: 医生俯身查看病人的影像片
scene: 医院里，医生对着影像片仔细查看每一处细节。The doctor examined the films slowly and carefully.
sceneCN: 这里 examine 是「检查」（第 1 个义项：仔细查看以了解状况）；句意：医院里，医生对着影像片仔细查看每一处细节。

senses.title: Looking closely
senses.definition: to look at something carefully to learn about it
senses.definitionCN: 仔细观察某物以了解情况
senses.example: The doctor examined her eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 医生检查了她的眼睛。
senses.why: The verb points a close look at one thing.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词指向对某一事物的仔细查看。

senses.title: Testing knowledge
senses.definition: to test what someone knows
senses.definitionCN: 测试某人掌握的知识
senses.example: The teacher examined the class in grammar.
senses.exampleCN: 老师对全班进行了语法考试。
senses.why: Testing is a way of weighing knowledge.
senses.whyCN: 测试是称量知识的一种方式。

senses.title: Questioning formally
senses.definition: to question someone officially
senses.definitionCN: 正式向某人提问
senses.example: The police examined the witness for an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 警方盘问了证人一小时。
senses.why: Questions dig out facts one by one.
senses.whyCN: 提问把事实一条条挖出来。

intro.en: Examine comes from Latin exigere, to weigh or drive out, through examen.
intro.cn: examine 经由 examen 源自拉丁语 exigere（称量、驱出）。

items.en: Exigere means to weigh or drive out.
items.cn: exigere 意为称量或驱出。

items.en: Examen is the tongue of a balance.
items.cn: examen 是天平的指针。

items.en: Old French examiner means to question.
items.cn: 古法语 examiner 意为盘问。

items.en: English examine first means to inspect closely.
items.cn: 英语 examine 最初指仔细查看。

items.en: Doctors now examine patients as a daily act.
items.cn: 如今医生每天都为病人做检查。

note.en: Examine is the verb; exam and examination are the nouns it stands behind.
note.cn: examine 是动词，exam 与 examination 是与之对应的名词。

entries.definition: a short word for an examination
a test or a careful check
to make sure something is right

normalIntro.en: To examine is to put something on the scales.
normalIntro.cn: examine 就是把某物放到天平上。

normal.en: An examiner is the person who examines.
normal.cn: examiner 就是进行 examine 的人。

normal.en: Examine the evidence before you judge.
normal.cn: 下判断前先审查证据。

normal.en: Doctors examine patients with care.
normal.cn: 医生仔细检查病人。

normal.en: Cross-examine means question again and again.
normal.cn: cross-examine 意为反复盘问。

normal.en: Examine is the verb behind examination.
normal.cn: examine 是 examination 背后的动词。

abstract.en: Picture hands turning a stone to see every side.
abstract.cn: 想象双手转动石头查看每一面。

abstract.en: Imagine a scale tipping under a question.
abstract.cn: 想象天平在一个问题下倾斜。

abstract.en: Think of a torch sweeping a dark room.
abstract.cn: 想象手电扫过黑暗的房间。

examples.en: The committee examined every report.
examples.cn: 委员会审查了每一份报告。

examples.en: She examined the map before the trip.
examples.cn: 出发前她仔细看了地图。

examples.en: The judge examined the witness calmly.
examples.cn: 法官平静地盘问证人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ amine」——把问题一条条挖出来，就是检查与考查。

root: 拉丁语 exigere（称量；驱出）→ examen（天平指针）→ examine，核心义「把事物放上天平逐一查看」。

sensesIntro.en: Examine means to look closely, to test knowledge, or to question officially.
sensesIntro.cn: examine 意为仔细查看、考查知识或正式盘问。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stone turned in the hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：在手中转动的石头。

branches.en: Turning the stone is the close look.
branches.cn: 转动石头就是仔细查看。

branches.en: Testing puts the learner on the scales.
branches.cn: 考查把学习者放上天平。

branches.en: Questions press the witness for facts.
branches.cn: 提问向证人追问事实。

branches.en: Both looking and testing are acts of weighing.
branches.cn: 查看与考查都是称量的动作。

branches.en: A test and an interrogation both ask questions.
branches.cn: 考试与审问都在提问。

intro.en: Examine goes back to Latin exigere, to weigh or drive out.
intro.cn: examine 可追溯到拉丁语 exigere（称量、驱出）。

latinIntro.en: Ex- plus agere, to drive, forms exigere, and examen follows.
latinIntro.cn: ex- 加 agere（驱动）构成 exigere，随后又有了 examen。

items.example: The examiner sat at the front.

items.exampleCN: exam 省略了长长的词尾。

latinEntries.example: Exigere is the source of examine.
latinEntries.exampleCN: exigere 是 examine 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Examen links weighing to testing.
latinEntries.exampleCN: examen 把称量与测试联系起来。

definition_en: something that shows what a rule, group or person is like
core_image: 黑板上圈出的一道示范例题
scene: 课堂上，老师用一道简单的题目说明新规则。The teacher gave one clear example of the rule.
sceneCN: 这里 example 是「例子」（第 1 个义项：用来说明规则的实例）；句意：课堂上，老师用一道简单的题目说明新规则。

senses.title: An instance
senses.definition: a thing that shows what a rule means
senses.definitionCN: 说明规则含义的具体事物
senses.example: Give me an example of a verb.
senses.exampleCN: 给我一个动词的例子。
senses.why: An instance is taken out to stand for the whole.
senses.whyCN: 取出一个实例来代表整体。

senses.title: A model
senses.definition: a person or act worth copying
senses.definitionCN: 值得效仿的人或行为
senses.example: She sets a good example for the class.
senses.exampleCN: 她为全班树立了好榜样。
senses.why: A good model is lifted out for others to follow.
senses.whyCN: 好榜样被挑出来供他人效仿。

senses.title: A specimen
senses.definition: one item that stands for a group
senses.definitionCN: 代表某一群体的一件物品
senses.example: This vase is a fine example of the style.
senses.exampleCN: 这只花瓶是该风格的范例。
senses.why: The sample shows what the rest are like.
senses.whyCN: 样品展示了其余的样子。

intro.en: Example comes from Latin exemplum, something taken out as a sample.
intro.cn: example 源自拉丁语 exemplum，即取出作为样品的东西。

items.en: Eximere means to take out.
items.cn: eximere 意为取出。

items.en: Exemplum is a sample or pattern.
items.cn: exemplum 是样品或范本。

items.en: Old French essample carries the sense of a model.
items.cn: 古法语 essample 带有榜样的含义。

items.en: English example keeps both sample and model.
items.cn: 英语 example 同时保留了样品与榜样的含义。

items.en: For example becomes a common phrase.
items.cn: for example 成为常用短语。

note.en: An example is taken out to show the rule; a sample is a piece of the whole.
note.cn: example 是被取出说明规则的实例，sample 是整体中的一份。

entries.definition: a short word for an examination
to show something by an example
a small part that shows the whole
a person or thing to copy

normalIntro.en: An example is one item taken out of the whole.
normalIntro.cn: example 是从整体中取出的一件样品。

normal.en: For example introduces an instance.
normal.cn: for example 引出实例。

normal.en: An example sentence shows a word in use.
normal.cn: example sentence 展示单词的用法。

normal.en: To set an example is to be a model.
normal.cn: set an example 就是做榜样。

normal.en: Follow the example of someone you trust.
normal.cn: follow the example 就是效仿你信任的人。

normal.en: Exemplify means to give an example.
normal.cn: exemplify 意为举例说明。

abstract.en: Picture one red apple standing for a whole basket.
abstract.cn: 想象一个红苹果代表一整篮。

abstract.en: Imagine a pattern piece cut from cloth.
abstract.cn: 想象从布料上剪下的样板。

abstract.en: Think of a signpost pointing the way.
abstract.cn: 想象一块指路的路牌。

examples.en: Can you give me another example?
examples.cn: 你能再给我一个例子吗？

examples.en: Her kindness is an example to us all.
examples.cn: 她的善良是我们所有人的榜样。

examples.en: This painting is a fine example of the style.
examples.cn: 这幅画是该风格的佳作范例。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ ample（取）」——从许多东西里取出一个，就是例子。

root: 拉丁语 eximere（取出）→ exemplum（取出的样品）→ 古法语 essample → example，核心义「从整体中取出一个作代表」。

sensesIntro.en: An example can be a single instance, a model to follow, or one item standing for a group.
sensesIntro.cn: example 可以是单个实例、可供效仿的榜样，或代表群体的一件样品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one apple shown from a full basket.
core.cn: 核心意象：从满篮苹果中拿出一个展示。

branches.en: One instance is taken out to show the rule.
branches.cn: 取出一个实例来说明规则。

branches.en: A model is lifted out for others to copy.
branches.cn: 榜样被挑出来供他人效仿。

branches.en: A specimen stands for the group it belongs to.
branches.cn: 样品代表它所属的群体。

branches.en: An instance and a model are both taken from many.
branches.cn: 实例与榜样都是从众多中取出的。

branches.en: The instance explains; the specimen represents.
branches.cn: 实例负责解释，样品负责代表。

intro.en: Example comes from Latin exemplum, a thing taken out.
intro.cn: example 源自拉丁语 exemplum，即被取出的东西。

latinIntro.en: Eximere, ex- plus emere, gives exemplum and then example.
latinIntro.cn: eximere 由 ex- 加 emere 构成，先有 exemplum，后有 example。

items.exampleCN: emere 出现在 redeem 中。
eximere 把两部分结合起来。

items.example: Essample carries the word into English.
Exemplar means a model to copy.
items.exampleCN: exemplar 意为可供效仿的典范。

latinEntries.example: Exemplum is the root of example.
latinEntries.exampleCN: exemplum 是 example 的词根。

latinEntries.example: Eximere explains the ex- at the front.
latinEntries.exampleCN: eximere 解释了词首的 ex-。

definition_en: extremely good in quality or performance
core_image: 舞台上赢得全场掌声的表演者
scene: 她在比赛中表现非常出色，赢得全场掌声。Her performance in the contest was excellent and won loud applause.
sceneCN: 这里 excellent 是「出色的」（第 1 个义项：质量或表现极佳）；句意：她在比赛中表现非常出色，赢得全场掌声。

senses.title: Of the best quality
senses.definition: extremely good in quality
senses.definitionCN: 质量上极其出色
senses.example: The hotel serves excellent food.
senses.exampleCN: 这家酒店提供极好的食物。
senses.why: Something excellent rises above the ordinary.
senses.whyCN: excellent 的东西高出一般水平。

senses.title: Very well done
senses.definition: showing very high ability in an activity
senses.definitionCN: 在某项活动中展现很高能力
senses.example: She was excellent in the debate.
senses.exampleCN: 她在辩论中表现出色。
senses.why: A high performance makes the person stand out.
senses.whyCN: 出色的表现让人脱颖而出。

senses.title: An exclamation of praise
senses.definition: used alone to show strong approval
senses.definitionCN: 单独使用以表示强烈赞许
senses.example: Excellent! We finished before noon.
senses.exampleCN: 好极了！我们中午前就完成了。
senses.why: One word can carry a whole verdict.
senses.whyCN: 一个词就能承载完整的评价。

intro.en: Excellent comes from Latin excellere, to rise above.
intro.cn: excellent 源自拉丁语 excellere，意为高出、超越。

items.en: Cellere means to rise or be high.
items.cn: cellere 意为升起或高耸。

items.en: Excellere means to stand out above others.
items.cn: excellere 意为高出他人。

items.en: French excellent keeps the sense of superiority.
items.cn: 法语 excellent 保留了优越之意。

items.en: English excellent praises high quality.
items.cn: 英语 excellent 赞扬高质量。

items.en: It also works as a one-word cheer.
items.cn: 它也可单独用作喝彩。

note.en: Excellent is stronger than good; outstanding is close to excellent.
note.cn: excellent 比 good 更强，outstanding 与 excellent 接近。

entries.definition: to be very good at something

normalIntro.en: Excellent means standing above the rest.
normalIntro.cn: excellent 意为高出其余。

normal.en: Excellent quality is the best quality.
normal.cn: excellent quality 就是最好的品质。

normal.en: An excellent idea solves the problem well.
normal.cn: an excellent idea 能很好解决问题。

normal.en: Excellent performance wins applause.
normal.cn: excellent performance 赢得掌声。

normal.en: Excellent at means very good at.
normal.cn: excellent at 意为非常擅长。

normal.en: Excellence is the noun from excellent.
normal.cn: excellence 是 excellent 的名词。

abstract.en: Picture a peak lifting above the mist.
abstract.cn: 想象一座高出云雾的山峰。

abstract.en: Imagine a gold medal catching the light.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚映着光的金牌。

abstract.en: Think of the top line of a report card.
abstract.cn: 想象成绩单最上面的那一行。

examples.en: She did an excellent job on the report.
examples.cn: 她把这份报告做得非常出色。

examples.en: The soup was excellent.
examples.cn: 这汤非常好喝。

examples.en: Excellent! Let us begin at once.
examples.cn: 好极了！我们马上开始吧。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ cellent（高）」——高出众人，就是优秀。

root: 拉丁语 excellere（高出）＝ ex-（出）＋ cellere（高耸）→ excellent，核心义「高出一般、超越众人」。

sensesIntro.en: Excellent means of the highest quality, very capable, or a word of strong praise.
sensesIntro.cn: excellent 意为品质极高、能力出众，或用作强烈赞许的感叹词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a peak above the clouds.
core.cn: 核心意象：高出云层的山峰。

branches.en: High quality is the leading sense.
branches.cn: 高质量是首要义项。

branches.en: Great skill shows in performance.
branches.cn: 高超能力体现在表现中。

branches.en: Strong praise becomes a one-word cheer.
branches.cn: 强烈赞许变成一词式喝彩。

branches.en: Good objects and good performances both rise above.
branches.cn: 好东西与好表现都高出一般。

branches.en: Skill earns the praise that the word carries.
branches.cn: 能力赢得这个词所承载的赞许。

intro.en: Excellent combines ex-, out, with Latin cellere, to rise.
intro.cn: excellent 由 ex-（出）与拉丁语 cellere（升起）组成。

latinIntro.en: Excellere gives French excellent and then English excellent.
latinIntro.cn: excellere 给出法语 excellent，再到英语 excellent。

latinEntries.example: Excellere is the root of excellent.
latinEntries.exampleCN: excellere 是 excellent 的词根。

definition_zh: 除…之外；除了；把…排除在外
definition_en: not including someone or something, or to leave them out
core_image: 空着的那个座位
scene: 所有学生都去了博物馆，只有她留在教室。All the students went to the museum except her.
sceneCN: 这里 except 是「除…之外」（第 1 个义项：不包括某人）；句意：所有学生都去了博物馆，只有她留在教室。

senses.title: Not including
senses.definition: used to say that someone or something is not included
senses.definitionCN: 用于表示某人或某物不包括在内
senses.example: The shop opens daily except Sunday.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店除周日外每天开门。
senses.why: The word lifts one item out of the group.
senses.whyCN: 这个词把一项从群体中拿出来。

senses.title: Only that
senses.definition: used to add a single correction or condition
senses.definitionCN: 用于补充一个例外情况或条件
senses.example: I would go, except that I am busy.
senses.exampleCN: 我本想去，只是我太忙了。
senses.why: One condition is taken out of the plan.
senses.whyCN: 一个条件被从计划中拿了出去。

senses.title: To leave out
senses.definition: to leave someone or something out on purpose
senses.definitionCN: 有意把某人或某物排除在外
senses.example: The rule excepts small orders.
senses.exampleCN: 该规则把小额订单排除在外。
senses.why: The verb turns the exception into an act.
senses.whyCN: 动词把「例外」变成一种行为。

intro.en: Except comes from Latin excipere, to take out.
intro.cn: except 源自拉丁语 excipere，意为取出。

items.en: Capere means to take.
items.cn: capere 意为拿取。

items.en: Excipere joins ex-, out, with capere, to take.
items.cn: excipere 由 ex-（出）与 capere（拿取）组成。

items.en: Old French excepter carries the sense of excluding.
items.cn: 古法语 excepter 保留排除之意。

items.en: English except marks the item left out.
items.cn: 英语 except 标记被排除的那一项。

items.en: Except for becomes a common phrase.
items.cn: except for 成为常用短语。

note.en: Except takes out one item; besides adds one more.
note.cn: except 拿走一项，besides 则是再加一项。

entries.definition: a case not following the rule
a short piece taken from a text

normalIntro.en: Except takes one item out of the group.
normalIntro.cn: except 把一项从群体中取出。

normal.en: Except for the rain, the day was fine.
normal.cn: except for 那场雨，这天很好。

normal.en: Everyone except Tom agreed.
normal.cn: everyone except Tom 除汤姆外大家都同意。

normal.en: Except that adds one exception.
normal.cn: except that 补充一个例外。

normal.en: Except when marks the only time.
normal.cn: except when 标记唯一的情况。

normal.en: Present company excepted means you are not included.
normal.cn: present company excepted 意为在座各位除外。

abstract.en: Picture one empty chair in a full room.
abstract.cn: 想象满屋人中有一把空椅子。

abstract.en: Imagine one apple left out of the basket.
abstract.cn: 想象一个苹果被留在篮子外面。

abstract.en: Think of a list with one line crossed out.
abstract.cn: 想象清单上有一条被划掉。

examples.en: The shop is open every day except Monday.
examples.cn: 这家店除周一外天天开门。

examples.en: I know nothing except that he left.
examples.cn: 除了他离开了，我什么都不知道。

examples.en: The policy excepts very small firms.
examples.cn: 该政策把很小的公司排除在外。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ cept（拿）」——从一堆里拿出来，就是除…之外。

root: 拉丁语 excipere（取出）＝ ex-（出）＋ capere（拿）→ except，核心义「把一项从整体中取出」。

sensesIntro.en: Except means not including, with one condition added, or to leave something out.
sensesIntro.cn: except 意为不包括、只补充一个例外条件，或把某物排除。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one chair left empty.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把空着的椅子。

branches.en: Leaving one item out is the main sense.
branches.cn: 取出一项是主要义项。

branches.en: A single condition is also taken out.
branches.cn: 单个条件同样被取出。

branches.en: The verb makes the exclusion deliberate.
branches.cn: 动词让排除成为有意的行为。

branches.en: Item and condition both stand outside the rule.
branches.cn: 项与条件都站在规则之外。

branches.en: What is excepted is left out of the count.
branches.cn: 被 except 的东西不被计入。

intro.en: Except combines ex-, out, with Latin capere, to take.
intro.cn: except 由 ex-（出）与拉丁语 capere（拿）组成。

latinIntro.en: Excipere gives French excepter and then English except.
latinIntro.cn: excipere 给出法语 excepter，再到英语 except。

items.exampleCN: capere 出现在 capture 中。

latinEntries.example: Excipere is the source of except.
latinEntries.exampleCN: excipere 是 except 的来源。

definition_en: a case that does not follow the rule, or an objection
core_image: 规则墙上贴着的一张特别说明
scene: 这条规则对每个人都适用，没有例外。The rule applies to everyone, with no exception.
sceneCN: 这里 exception 是「例外」（第 1 个义项：不遵循规则的个例）；句意：这条规则对每个人都适用，没有例外。

senses.title: A case outside the rule
senses.definition: a person or case not covered by a rule
senses.definitionCN: 不受某条规则约束的人或情况
senses.example: Everyone must pay, without exception.
senses.exampleCN: 每个人都必须付钱，无一例外。
senses.why: One case is taken out of the general rule.
senses.whyCN: 一个情况被从通则中取出。

senses.title: Leaving out
senses.definition: the act of not including someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 不把某人或某物包括进来的行为
senses.example: With the exception of Tom, all agreed.
senses.exampleCN: 除汤姆外，大家都同意了。
senses.why: The phrase marks what has been left out.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语标记被排除的东西。

senses.title: An objection
senses.definition: a strong disagreement with something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事的强烈反对
senses.example: She took exception to his tone.
senses.exampleCN: 她对他的语气表示异议。
senses.why: To object is to set your view outside the rest.
senses.whyCN: 反对就是把你的看法置于其余之外。

intro.en: Exception comes from Latin exceptio, a taking out or a special case.
intro.cn: exception 源自拉丁语 exceptio，意为取出或特例。

items.en: Excipere means to take out.
items.cn: excipere 意为取出。

items.en: Exceptio is the act of taking out.
items.cn: exceptio 是取出的行为。

items.en: French exception names a special case.
items.cn: 法语 exception 指特例。

items.en: English exception keeps the legal flavour.
items.cn: 英语 exception 保留了法律色彩。

items.en: Take exception means object.
items.cn: take exception 意为提出异议。

note.en: An exception leaves the rule; an anomaly is a strange case itself.
note.cn: exception 是规则之外的个例，anomaly 是本身反常的现象。

entries.definition: something that differs from the norm

normalIntro.en: An exception is a case held outside the rule.
normalIntro.cn: exception 是被留在规则之外的情况。

normal.en: To make an exception is to allow one special case.
normal.cn: make an exception 就是允许一个特例。

normal.en: With the exception of means except.
normal.cn: with the exception of 意为除…之外。

normal.en: No exception means the rule is firm.
normal.cn: no exception 意为规则毫不松动。

normal.en: Take exception to means object to.
normal.cn: take exception to 意为对…提出异议。

normal.en: An exception proves the rule.
normal.cn: 有例外反而说明规则成立。

abstract.en: Picture one red door in a white wall.
abstract.cn: 想象白墙上的一扇红门。

abstract.en: Imagine one footnote under a long page.
abstract.cn: 想象长页下方的一条脚注。

abstract.en: Think of one stone left on the wrong bank.
abstract.cn: 想象一块被遗在错误岸边的石头。

examples.en: This is an exception to the usual rule.
examples.cn: 这是通常规则的一个例外。

examples.en: They made an exception for her age.
examples.cn: 他们因为她的年龄破了例。

examples.en: He took exception to the unfair remark.
examples.cn: 他对那句不公平的话表示异议。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「except（除）＋ ion」——被除去的那一个，就是例外。

root: 拉丁语 exceptio（取出）→ 古法语 exception → exception，核心义「被从通则中取出的特例」。

sensesIntro.en: An exception is a case outside a rule, the act of leaving something out, or an objection.
sensesIntro.cn: exception 指规则之外的个例、排除在外的行为，或异议。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one case standing outside a rule.
core.cn: 核心意象：站在规则之外的个例。

branches.en: The special case is the main sense.
branches.cn: 特例是主要义项。

branches.en: Leaving something out is the act.
branches.cn: 排除在外是一种行为。

branches.en: Objection sets one voice outside the rest.
branches.cn: 异议让一个声音站到其余之外。

branches.en: A special case is what has been left out.
branches.cn: 特例就是被排除在外的那个。

branches.en: Exclusion and objection both divide a group.
branches.cn: 排除与异议都在划分群体。

intro.en: Exception is except plus the noun suffix -ion.
intro.cn: exception 是 except 加名词后缀 -ion。

latinIntro.en: Latin exceptio comes from excipere, to take out.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exceptio 来自 excipere（取出）。

latinEntries.example: Exceptio is the root of exception.
latinEntries.exampleCN: exceptio 是 exception 的词根。

definition_en: to give something and receive something else in return
core_image: 车站里互相递出电话号码的两个人
scene: 两人在车站交换了电话号码。The two of them exchanged phone numbers at the station.
sceneCN: 这里 exchange 是「交换」（第 1 个义项：给出一样东西并换回另一样）；句意：两人在车站交换了电话号码。

senses.title: Swapping things
senses.definition: to give one thing and get another in return
senses.definitionCN: 给出一样东西并换回另一样
senses.example: They exchanged books after class.
senses.exampleCN: 课后他们交换了书。
senses.why: Each hand takes and gives at the same moment.
senses.whyCN: 每只手在同一时刻既拿又给。

senses.title: Changing money
senses.definition: to change money of one country for another
senses.definitionCN: 把一国货币换成另一国货币
senses.example: We exchanged dollars for local money.
senses.exampleCN: 我们把美元换成了当地货币。
senses.why: Currency is swapped like any other goods.
senses.whyCN: 货币像其他货物一样被互换。

senses.title: A talk or argument
senses.definition: a conversation or short argument between people
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间的交谈或短暂争执
senses.example: They had a sharp exchange of words.
senses.exampleCN: 他们发生了激烈的口角。
senses.why: Words are handed back and forth like objects.
senses.whyCN: 话语像物品一样被来回递送。

intro.en: Exchange comes from Old French eschangier, from Latin cambiare, to barter.
intro.cn: exchange 源自古法语 eschangier，来自拉丁语 cambiare（以物易物）。

items.en: Cambiare means to barter or swap.
items.cn: cambiare 意为以物易物。

items.en: Eschangier adds the sense of giving in turn.
items.cn: eschangier 增加了轮流给予的含义。

items.en: Exchange enters English as a verb of swapping.
items.cn: exchange 以交换动词之意进入英语。

items.en: Currency exchange becomes a daily need.
items.cn: 货币兑换成为日常需求。

items.en: Exchange student names a school visitor.
items.cn: exchange student 指来校交流的学生。

note.en: Exchange is a two-way swap; change alone means make different.
note.cn: exchange 是双向互换，change 单指改变。

entries.definition: to exchange one thing for another
to buy and sell or swap

normalIntro.en: Exchange is a two-way hand-over.
normalIntro.cn: exchange 就是双向递交。

normal.en: The exchange rate tells what money is worth.
normal.cn: exchange rate 告诉我们货币的价值。

normal.en: Exchange ideas means share thoughts.
normal.cn: exchange ideas 意为分享想法。

normal.en: In exchange for means as a swap for.
normal.cn: in exchange for 意为作为…的交换。

normal.en: Foreign exchange deals with other currencies.
normal.cn: foreign exchange 涉及外币。

normal.en: An exchange student studies in another country.
normal.cn: exchange student 在另一个国家学习。

abstract.en: Picture two hands passing letters.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手互相递信。

abstract.en: Imagine two coins sliding across a counter.
abstract.cn: 想象两枚硬币在柜台上滑过。

abstract.en: Think of words flying back and forth.
abstract.cn: 想象话语来回飞舞。

examples.en: We exchanged gifts at the party.
examples.cn: 我们在聚会上交换了礼物。

examples.en: The bank exchanges foreign money.
examples.cn: 这家银行兑换外币。

examples.en: There was a short exchange of views.
examples.cn: 双方简短地交换了意见。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ change（换）」——把东西拿出来换，就是交换。

root: 拉丁语 cambiare（以物易物）→ 古法语 eschangier → exchange，核心义「双方互相给出并取得」。

sensesIntro.en: Exchange means to swap things, change currency, or have a talk or brief argument.
sensesIntro.cn: exchange 意为互换物品、兑换货币，或进行交谈与短暂争执。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands passing things.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手互相递交。

branches.en: Swapping objects is the core sense.
branches.cn: 交换物品是核心义项。

branches.en: Money is swapped on the same pattern.
branches.cn: 货币按同样模式互换。

branches.en: Words also travel in both directions.
branches.cn: 话语也双向流动。

branches.en: Goods and money both pass hand to hand.
branches.cn: 货物与钱都手手相传。

branches.en: A talk is an exchange of ideas.
branches.cn: 交谈就是想法的交换。

intro.en: Exchange joins ex-, out, with change.
intro.cn: exchange 由 ex-（出）与 change 组成。

latinIntro.en: Latin cambiare, to barter, is the older root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cambiare（以物易物）是更早的词根。

items.example: Exchangeable means able to be swapped.
The compound names a money price.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词指货币价格。
这个复合词指来访学生。

latinEntries.example: Cambiare is the old root of exchange.
latinEntries.exampleCN: cambiare 是 exchange 的古老词根。

definition_en: to make someone feel eager or to cause a strong feeling
core_image: 听到出游消息后跳起来的孩子
scene: 孩子们听说要去动物园，兴奋地跳了起来。The children were excited to hear about the zoo trip and jumped up.
sceneCN: 这里 excite 是「使兴奋」（第 1 个义项：让人产生强烈期待与热情）；句意：孩子们听说要去动物园，兴奋地跳了起来。

senses.title: To make eager
senses.definition: to make someone feel happy and eager
senses.definitionCN: 让人感到快乐而期待
senses.example: The news excited the whole school.
senses.exampleCN: 这个消息让全校都兴奋起来。
senses.why: Good news sets the feelings in motion.
senses.whyCN: 好消息让情绪动了起来。

senses.title: To cause a feeling
senses.definition: to cause interest, curiosity or another feeling
senses.definitionCN: 引起兴趣、好奇或其他感受
senses.example: The strange box excited her curiosity.
senses.exampleCN: 那个奇怪的盒子激起了她的好奇。
senses.why: A feeling is called out and set moving.
senses.whyCN: 感受被唤起并开始活动。

senses.title: To stir up
senses.definition: to stir people into strong action or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 鼓动人们产生强烈行动或情绪
senses.example: The speech excited the crowd to cheer.
senses.exampleCN: 演讲让观众欢呼起来。
senses.why: Excitement spreads from one person to many.
senses.whyCN: 兴奋会从一个人传向许多人。

intro.en: Excite comes from Latin excitare, to call out or set in motion.
intro.cn: excite 源自拉丁语 excitare，意为唤出或使动起来。

items.en: Citare means to call or urge.
items.cn: citare 意为呼唤或催促。

items.en: Excitare adds ex-, out, to citare.
items.cn: excitare 在 citare 前加了 ex-（出）。

items.en: French exciter keeps the sense of stirring.
items.cn: 法语 exciter 保留激起之意。

items.en: English excite covers feelings and interest.
items.cn: 英语 excite 涵盖情绪与兴趣。

items.en: Excited and exciting split into two adjectives.
items.cn: excited 与 exciting 分化为两个形容词。

note.en: Excited describes the feeler; exciting describes the cause.
note.cn: excited 形容人的感受，exciting 形容引起感受的事物。

entries.definition: to give a sudden strong feeling
to cause a feeling or response

normalIntro.en: To excite is to set a feeling running.
normalIntro.cn: excite 就是让一种感受跑起来。

normal.en: Excite interest means make people curious.
normal.cn: excite interest 意为让人产生兴趣。

normal.en: Excite curiosity means wake up wonder.
normal.cn: excite curiosity 意为唤起好奇。

normal.en: Excite the crowd means fill them with energy.
normal.cn: excite the crowd 意为让观众充满能量。

normal.en: Get excited about means look forward eagerly.
normal.cn: get excited about 意为热切期待。

normal.en: Exciting describes the cause; excited describes you.
normal.cn: exciting 描述原因，excited 描述你自己。

abstract.en: Picture sparks jumping between two wires.
abstract.cn: 想象两根电线间跳起的火花。

abstract.en: Imagine a crowd rising like one wave.
abstract.cn: 想象人群像一道浪一起涌起。

abstract.en: Think of a child's feet leaving the floor.
abstract.cn: 想象孩子的双脚离开地面。

examples.en: The film excited the whole audience.
examples.cn: 这部电影让全场观众兴奋不已。

examples.en: Nothing seems to excite him these days.
examples.cn: 这些天似乎没有什么能让他兴奋。

examples.en: The plan excited a lot of interest.
examples.cn: 这个计划引起了很多兴趣。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ cite（呼叫）」——把情绪喊出来，就是使兴奋。

root: 拉丁语 excitare（唤出、使动）＝ ex-（出）＋ citare（呼叫）→ excite，核心义「把情绪唤起并推向前」。

sensesIntro.en: Excite means to make someone eager, to cause a feeling, or to stir people up.
sensesIntro.cn: excite 意为使人兴奋、激起某种感受，或鼓动人群。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sparks jumping between wires.
core.cn: 核心意象：电线间跳动的火花。

branches.en: Making someone eager is the main sense.
branches.cn: 使人期待是主要义项。

branches.en: Any feeling can be called out.
branches.cn: 任何感受都可以被唤起。

branches.en: Stirring a crowd spreads the energy.
branches.cn: 鼓动人群会让能量扩散。

branches.en: Joy and curiosity are both set in motion.
branches.cn: 快乐与好奇都被启动。

branches.en: A feeling becomes a movement in a group.
branches.cn: 感受在群体中变成行动。

intro.en: Excite joins ex-, out, with Latin citare, to call.
intro.cn: excite 由 ex-（出）与拉丁语 citare（呼叫）组成。

latinIntro.en: Excitare is the direct Latin verb behind excite.
latinIntro.cn: excitare 是 excite 背后的直接拉丁动词。

latinEntries.example: Excitare is the source of excite.
latinEntries.exampleCN: excitare 是 excite 的来源。

definition_zh: 兴奋；激动；令人兴奋的事物
definition_en: a strong feeling of eager happiness or nervous energy
core_image: 音乐会开场前大厅里的低语
scene: 音乐会开始前，大厅里满是兴奋的低语。Before the concert, excitement filled the hall in low whispers.
sceneCN: 这里 excitement 是「兴奋」（第 1 个义项：强烈而期待的情绪）；句意：音乐会开始前，大厅里满是兴奋的低语。

pos.zh: 兴奋；激动；令人兴奋的事物

senses.title: Eager happiness
senses.definition: a happy feeling of looking forward to something
senses.definitionCN: 期待某事时的快乐感受
senses.example: Her eyes shone with excitement.
senses.exampleCN: 她兴奋得眼睛发亮。
senses.why: The feeling rises when something good is near.
senses.whyCN: 好事临近时这种感受就会升起。

senses.title: Nervous stir
senses.definition: a state of strong nervous energy
senses.definitionCN: 强烈而不安的情绪状态
senses.example: The crowd was in a state of excitement.
senses.exampleCN: 人群处于激动的状态。
senses.why: The same energy can be joy or nerves.
senses.whyCN: 同一种能量既可以是喜悦，也可以是紧张。

senses.title: An exciting thing
senses.definition: an event or activity that causes strong feeling
senses.definitionCN: 引起强烈感受的事件或活动
senses.example: The trip was full of excitement.
senses.exampleCN: 这次旅行充满令人兴奋的事。
senses.why: The feeling and the cause share one name.
senses.whyCN: 感受与原因共用一个名称。

intro.en: Excitement comes from exciter, the French verb from Latin excitare.
intro.cn: excitement 来自法语动词 exciter，其源头是拉丁语 excitare。

items.en: Excitare means to call out.
items.cn: excitare 意为唤出。

items.en: Exciter means to stir up.
items.cn: exciter 意为激起。

items.en: Excitement names the stirred state.
items.cn: excitement 指被激起的这种状态。

items.en: It covers both joy and nerves.
items.cn: 它同时涵盖喜悦与紧张。

items.en: The plural is rare but appears in travel writing.
items.cn: 复数形式少见，但会出现在游记中。

note.en: Excitement is the feeling; alarming is different; thrill is a stronger burst.
note.cn: excitement 是这种感受，thrill 是更强烈的爆发。

entries.definition: a sudden strong feeling of joy

normalIntro.en: Excitement is the inner spark before something begins.
normalIntro.cn: excitement 就是事情开始前心里的火花。

normal.en: In excitement means with a racing heart.
normal.cn: in excitement 意为心里怦怦跳地。

normal.en: Great excitement filled the room.
normal.cn: great excitement 充满了房间。

normal.en: Excitement about the trip kept them awake.
normal.cn: 对旅行的兴奋让他们睡不着。

normal.en: The news caused great excitement.
normal.cn: 这个消息引起了极大兴奋。

normal.en: The excitement of travel comes from the unknown.
normal.cn: the excitement of travel 来自未知。

abstract.en: Picture hands clapping before the lights go up.
abstract.cn: 想象灯光亮起前响起的掌声。

abstract.en: Imagine a child's first look at the sea.
abstract.cn: 想象孩子第一次看见大海。

abstract.en: Think of a crowd holding its breath.
abstract.cn: 想象人群屏住呼吸。

examples.en: The children could hardly hide their excitement.
examples.cn: 孩子们几乎藏不住兴奋。

examples.en: There was great excitement about the new bridge.
examples.cn: 人们为这座新桥兴奋不已。

examples.en: He spoke with excitement in his voice.
examples.cn: 他说话时声音里带着激动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「excite（使兴奋）＋ ment」——被唤起的状态，就是兴奋。

root: 拉丁语 excitare（唤出）→ 法语 exciter → excite ＋ -ment → excitement，核心义「被唤起并持续着的强烈情绪」。

sensesIntro.en: Excitement is eager happiness, nervous energy, or the event that stirs them.
sensesIntro.cn: excitement 是期待中的快乐、紧张的能量，或引起它们的事件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a spark before the show begins.
core.cn: 核心意象：演出开始前的火花。

branches.en: Looking forward is the main feeling.
branches.cn: 期待是主要感受。

branches.en: The same energy can turn nervous.
branches.cn: 同样的能量也可能变紧张。

branches.en: The cause and the feeling share one word.
branches.cn: 原因与感受共用一个词。

branches.en: Joy and nerves both raise the pulse.
branches.cn: 喜悦与紧张都会让脉搏加快。

branches.en: A trip can both cause and be the excitement.
branches.cn: 旅行既能引起兴奋，也能就是那件令人兴奋的事。

intro.en: Excitement is excite plus the noun suffix -ment.
intro.cn: excitement 是 excite 加名词后缀 -ment。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb excitare is the deepest source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词 excitare 是最深的来源。

items.example: -ment turns the verb into a noun.

latinEntries.example: Excitare is the source of excitement.
latinEntries.exampleCN: excitare 是 excitement 的来源。

definition_zh: 排除；不包括；把…拒之门外
definition_en: to keep someone or something out, or to leave them out
core_image: 名额已满后关上的门
scene: 因为名额有限，主办方不得不把一些申请者排除在外。Because places were limited, the organizers had to exclude some applicants.
sceneCN: 这里 exclude 是「把…排除在外」（第 1 个义项：不让某人进入或参与）；句意：因为名额有限，主办方不得不把一些申请者排除在外。

senses.title: Keeping someone out
senses.definition: to stop someone from entering or joining
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某人进入或加入
senses.example: The club excluded women for years.
senses.exampleCN: 这家俱乐部多年来排斥女性。
senses.why: The word closes a door on someone.
senses.whyCN: 这个词对某人关上了门。

senses.title: Not including
senses.definition: to leave something out of a group or list
senses.definitionCN: 把某物从群体或清单中略去
senses.example: The price excludes delivery.
senses.exampleCN: 价格不含送货费。
senses.why: One item is kept outside the count.
senses.whyCN: 一项被留在计数之外。

senses.title: Ruling out
senses.definition: to decide that something is not possible
senses.definitionCN: 断定某事不可能
senses.example: We cannot exclude the possibility of rain.
senses.exampleCN: 我们不能排除下雨的可能。
senses.why: A possibility is shut out of the answer.
senses.whyCN: 一种可能被关在答案之外。

intro.en: Exclude comes from Latin excludere, to shut out.
intro.cn: exclude 源自拉丁语 excludere，意为关在外面。

items.en: Claudere means to close or shut.
items.cn: claudere 意为关闭。

items.en: Excludere joins ex-, out, with claudere.
items.cn: excludere 由 ex-（出）与 claudere 组成。

items.en: French exclure keeps the sense of shutting out.
items.cn: 法语 exclure 保留关在外面之意。

items.en: English exclude covers people, items and ideas.
items.cn: 英语 exclude 涵盖人、物品与想法。

items.en: Excluding tax becomes a set phrase.
items.cn: excluding tax 成为固定短语。

note.en: Exclude is the opposite of include.
note.cn: exclude 是 include 的反义词。

normalIntro.en: To exclude is to close the door on someone.
normalIntro.cn: exclude 就是对某人关上门。

normal.en: Exclude from means keep out of a group.
normal.cn: exclude from 意为不让进入某个群体。

normal.en: Exclude the possibility means rule it out.
normal.cn: exclude the possibility 意为排除这种可能。

normal.en: The price excludes delivery.
normal.cn: 价格不含送货费。

normal.en: Excluding tax means before tax is added.
normal.cn: excluding tax 意为未加税前。

normal.en: Exclusion is the noun from exclude.
normal.cn: exclusion 是 exclude 的名词。

abstract.en: Picture a door closing in front of someone.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门在某人面前关上。

abstract.en: Imagine one name crossed off a list.
abstract.cn: 想象清单上一个名字被划掉。

abstract.en: Think of a gate locked after the last guest.
abstract.cn: 想象最后一位客人之后大门上锁。

examples.en: The list excludes names with no address.
examples.cn: 这份清单排除了没有地址的名字。

examples.en: Nobody should be excluded because of age.
examples.cn: 任何人都不应因年龄被排斥。

examples.en: We cannot exclude a later change.
examples.cn: 我们不能排除以后会有变化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ clude（关）」——关在门外，就是排除。

root: 拉丁语 excludere（关在外面）＝ ex-（出）＋ claudere（关闭）→ exclude，核心义「把人或事物关在范围之外」。

sensesIntro.en: Exclude means to keep someone out, leave something out, or rule out a possibility.
sensesIntro.cn: exclude 意为把某人拒之门外、不包括某物，或排除某种可能。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door closed on someone.
core.cn: 核心意象：对某人关上的门。

branches.en: Keeping a person out is the main sense.
branches.cn: 把人挡在外面是主要义项。

branches.en: An item can be left out of a list.
branches.cn: 一项可以被从清单中略去。

branches.en: A possibility can be shut out of thought.
branches.cn: 一种可能可以被排除在考虑之外。

branches.en: People and items both stay outside.
branches.cn: 人与物品都被留在外面。

branches.en: Omitting a fact can rule out an option.
branches.cn: 略去一个事实可能排除一个选项。

intro.en: Exclude joins ex-, out, with Latin claudere, to close.
intro.cn: exclude 由 ex-（出）与拉丁语 claudere（关闭）组成。

latinIntro.en: Claudere also lies behind close and clause.
latinIntro.cn: claudere 也是 close 与 clause 的来源。

items.exampleCN: claudere 出现在 clause 中。
exclusive 意为把他人排除在外。

latinEntries.example: Excludere is the source of exclude.
latinEntries.exampleCN: excludere 是 exclude 的来源。

definition_zh: 原谅；为…辩解；免除；借口；理由
definition_en: to forgive a fault, to give a reason in defense, or to release someone from duty
core_image: 一面薄纸做的小盾牌
scene: 他迟到了，却把堵车当作借口。He was late and offered heavy traffic as an excuse.
sceneCN: 这里 excuse 是「借口、理由」（第 2 个义项）；句意：他迟到了，却把堵车当作借口。

senses.title: Forgive
senses.definition: to forgive a small fault or bad behavior
senses.definitionCN: 原谅小的过失或不当行为
senses.example: Please excuse my late reply.
senses.exampleCN: 请原谅我回复晚了。
senses.why: The fault is lifted off the person.
senses.whyCN: 过失被人从身上拿开。

senses.title: Reason offered
senses.definition: a reason that you give to explain or defend your behavior
senses.definitionCN: 用来解释或为自己行为辩护的理由
senses.example: He gave a weak excuse for missing the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 他为没参加会议给了一个牵强的借口。
senses.why: The reason works like a shield held against blame.
senses.whyCN: 理由像一面挡在责备前的盾牌。

senses.title: Release from duty
senses.definition: to allow someone to leave a duty or place
senses.definitionCN: 准许某人免除某项义务或离开某地
senses.example: The teacher excused her from the test.
senses.exampleCN: 老师准许她不参加这次考试。
senses.why: The person is taken out of the obligation.
senses.whyCN: 这个人被从义务中取了出来。

intro.en: Excuse comes from Latin excusare, to free from blame.
intro.cn: excuse 源自拉丁语 excusare，意为使免于责备。

items.en: Causa means cause or legal charge.
items.cn: causa 意为原因或指控。

items.en: Excusare joins ex-, out, with causa, charge.
items.cn: excusare 由 ex-（出）与 causa（指控）组成。

items.en: Excusare means to take the charge away.
items.cn: excusare 意为把指控拿走。

items.en: Old French escuser softens the spelling.
items.cn: 古法语 escuser 使拼写变柔和。

items.en: English excuse covers both forgive and reason.
items.cn: 英语 excuse 同时涵盖原谅与理由。

note.en: Excuse removes blame; accuse places it.
note.cn: excuse 把责备拿走，accuse 则把责备放上去。

normalIntro.en: Excuse lifts blame away with a shield of reasons.
normalIntro.cn: excuse 用理由做盾牌，把责备挡开。

normal.en: Excuse me, could you help me?
normal.cn: 打扰一下，你能帮我吗？

normal.en: He made an excuse for being late.
normal.cn: 他为迟到找了个借口。

normal.en: The teacher excused him from class.
normal.cn: 老师准许他不上课。

normal.en: A poor excuse fools no one.
normal.cn: 牵强的借口骗不了人。

normal.en: She was excused from the meeting.
normal.cn: 她获准不参加这次会议。

abstract.en: Picture a note that lifts a small blame.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸条把小小的责备提起拿走。

abstract.en: Imagine a hall pass that lets you leave.
abstract.cn: 想象一张允许你离开的通行条。

abstract.en: Think of a thin paper shield held against blame.
abstract.cn: 想象一面薄纸盾牌挡在责备之前。

examples.en: Please excuse the mess in the kitchen.
examples.cn: 请原谅厨房里的凌乱。

examples.en: Her excuse for the delay sounded true.
examples.cn: 她迟到的理由听起来是真的。

examples.en: The coach excused him from training.
examples.cn: 教练准许他不参加训练。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ cuse（原因）」——给个原因把自己从责备里拿出来，就是借口与原谅。

root: 拉丁语 excusare（免于指控）＝ ex-（出）＋ causa（指控、原因）→ excuse，核心义「把责任从身上拿出」。

sensesIntro.en: Excuse means to forgive, a reason given in defense, or to release someone from duty.
sensesIntro.cn: excuse 意为原谅、为自己辩护的理由，或准许某人免除义务。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin paper shield.
core.cn: 核心意象：一面薄纸盾牌。

branches.en: Forgiving a small fault is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 原谅小过失是日常用法。

branches.en: A reason is offered as a shield.
branches.cn: 理由被当作盾牌递出。

branches.en: The verb can also waive a duty.
branches.cn: 这个动词还能免除义务。

branches.en: Forgiveness and reasons both remove blame.
branches.cn: 原谅与理由都能移除责备。

branches.en: Reason and release both let the person off.
branches.cn: 理由与免除都让人得以脱身。

intro.en: Excuse combines ex-, out, with Latin causa, cause or charge.
intro.cn: excuse 由 ex-（出）与拉丁语 causa（原因、指控）组成。

latinIntro.en: Excusare gives Old French escuser and then English excuse.
latinIntro.cn: excusare 给出古法语 escuser，再到英语 excuse。

items.example: Inexcusable means no excuse is possible.
items.exampleCN: inexcusable 意为毫无借口可言。

latinEntries.example: Excusare is the source of excuse.
latinEntries.exampleCN: excusare 是 excuse 的来源。

definition_zh: 主管；高管；行政的；执行的；高档的
definition_en: a senior manager, the branch that carries out decisions, or goods made for top staff
core_image: 顶层那间有最终决定权的办公室
scene: 董事会任命了一位新主管负责日常运营。The board appointed a new executive to run daily operations.
sceneCN: 这里 executive 是「主管、高管」（第 1 个义项）；句意：董事会任命了一位新主管负责日常运营。

senses.title: Top manager
senses.definition: a senior manager who makes important decisions in a company
senses.definitionCN: 在公司中做出重要决策的高级管理者
senses.example: The executive approved the new budget.
senses.exampleCN: 这位主管批准了新预算。
senses.why: The person at the top turns decisions into orders.
senses.whyCN: 顶层的人把决定变成指令。

senses.title: Administrative
senses.definition: connected with carrying out decisions and managing an organization
senses.definitionCN: 与执行决定和管理组织有关的
senses.example: The committee has executive power over spending.
senses.exampleCN: 该委员会在开支上拥有行政权。
senses.why: This branch of power is the one that acts.
senses.whyCN: 这一权力分支负责实际采取行动。

senses.title: High grade
senses.definition: designed for senior staff or wealthy customers
senses.definitionCN: 为高级职员或富裕顾客设计的
senses.example: They booked an executive suite on the top floor.
senses.exampleCN: 他们预订了顶层的行政套房。
senses.why: Even rooms borrow the status of the top floor.
senses.whyCN: 连房间也借用了顶层的身份感。

intro.en: Executive comes from Latin exsequi, to carry out.
intro.cn: executive 源自拉丁语 exsequi，意为执行到底。

items.en: Sequi means to follow.
items.cn: sequi 意为跟随。

items.en: Exsequi means to follow a task through.
items.cn: exsequi 意为把任务贯彻到底。

items.en: Executivus marks the power to carry out.
items.cn: executivus 标记付诸执行的权力。

items.en: French executif names the branch that acts.
items.cn: 法语 executif 指负责行动的那一支。

items.en: English executive extends to senior managers and luxury goods.
items.cn: 英语 executive 扩展到高级管理者与高档用品。

note.en: An executive decides and acts; a manager runs daily work.
note.cn: executive 决策并推动行动，manager 则负责日常运转。

entries.definition: a person who carries out a will
a person who runs daily work
a person who manages an organization
a member of a company board

normalIntro.en: An executive sits where decisions become action.
normalIntro.cn: executive 坐在决定变成行动的位置上。

normal.en: The chief executive sets the direction.
normal.cn: 首席执行官定下方向。

normal.en: Executive power belongs to the cabinet.
normal.cn: 行政权属于内阁。

normal.en: An executive director sits on the board.
normal.cn: 执行董事坐在董事会里。

normal.en: The executive suite has its own lounge.
normal.cn: 行政套房有自己的休息厅。

normal.en: Senior executives met to discuss the merger.
normal.cn: 高级主管们开会讨论合并。

abstract.en: Picture a corner office with the final say.
abstract.cn: 想象一间拥有最终决定权的拐角办公室。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand that signs and the plan moves.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手签下名字，计划就动起来。

abstract.en: Think of the top floor where decisions are made.
abstract.cn: 想象顶层那个做决定的楼层。

examples.en: The executive team meets every Monday.
examples.cn: 高管团队每周一开会。

examples.en: She became an executive at a young age.
examples.cn: 她年纪轻轻就成了高管。

examples.en: They stayed in an executive suite for the conference.
examples.cn: 他们为参加会议住进了行政套房。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「execut（执行）＋ ive」——负责拍板并推动执行的人就是主管；属于决策层的，就是行政的、高档的。

root: 拉丁语 exsequi（执行到底）→ executivus（有执行权的）→ executive，核心义「把决定付诸行动的人与层级」。

sensesIntro.en: Executive means a senior manager, the branch that carries out decisions, or goods made for top staff.
sensesIntro.cn: executive 意为高级管理者、负责执行的权力分支，或为高层服务的高档用品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a corner office with the final say.
core.cn: 核心意象：拥有最终决定权的拐角办公室。

branches.en: The person who decides is the main sense.
branches.cn: 做决定的人是主要义项。

branches.en: The adjective marks the acting branch.
branches.cn: 形容词义标记负责行动的分支。

latinIntro.cn: executivus 来自 exsequi，再传入法语与英语。

definition_zh: 锻炼；练习；行使；运用；体操
definition_en: physical activity, a set task for practice, or the use of a power or right
core_image: 清晨公园里跑步的人
scene: 医生建议她每天锻炼半小时。The doctor advised her to exercise for half an hour every day.
sceneCN: 这里 exercise 是「锻炼」（第 1 个义项）；句意：医生建议她每天锻炼半小时。

senses.title: Physical activity
senses.definition: activity that you do with your body to stay healthy
senses.definitionCN: 为保持健康而进行的身体活动
senses.example: Regular exercise keeps the heart strong.
senses.exampleCN: 经常锻炼能让心脏强健。
senses.why: The body is kept busy and trained.
senses.whyCN: 身体被持续使用并得到训练。

senses.title: Practice task
senses.definition: a set of questions or tasks used for practice
senses.definitionCN: 用于练习的一组问题或任务
senses.example: The students finished the grammar exercises.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们做完了语法练习。
senses.why: Practice keeps a skill active, like exercise for the body.
senses.whyCN: 练习让技能保持活跃，如同身体的锻炼。

senses.title: Use of power
senses.definition: to use a power, right, or quality
senses.definitionCN: 使用某种权力、权利或特质
senses.example: The mayor exercised her right to veto.
senses.exampleCN: 市长行使了否决权。
senses.why: A right is put into action, not left unused.
senses.whyCN: 权利被投入行动，而不是搁置不用。

intro.en: Exercise comes from Latin exercere, to keep busy or drive on.
intro.cn: exercise 源自拉丁语 exercere，意为使忙碌、驱使。

items.en: Arcere means to keep away or drive off.
items.cn: arcere 意为挡住或赶走。

items.en: Exercere joins ex- with arcere and means to drive on.
items.cn: exercere 由 ex- 与 arcere 结合，意为驱策前进。

items.en: Exercere covers training the body and working a field.
items.cn: exercere 既指训练身体，也指耕作田地。

items.en: Old French exercice narrows the word to practice.
items.cn: 古法语 exercice 把词义收窄到练习。

items.en: English exercise adds the use of rights and powers.
items.cn: 英语 exercise 增加了行使权利与权力的含义。

note.en: Exercise trains the body; exorcise drives out a spirit.
note.cn: exercise 训练身体，exorcise 则驱赶鬼魂。

entries.definition: to drive out an evil spirit
a person or machine used for exercise
able to be used as a right
repeated activity to improve a skill
teaching or exercise for a skill

normalIntro.en: Exercise keeps body and skill busy and strong.
normalIntro.cn: exercise 让身体与技能保持忙碌而强健。

normal.en: Take exercise before breakfast if you can.
normal.cn: 如果可以，早饭前锻炼一下。

normal.en: Physical exercise protects the heart.
normal.cn: 体育锻炼保护心脏。

normal.en: Do the exercises after each lesson.
normal.cn: 每课后做这些练习。

normal.en: The mayor exercised her veto power.
normal.cn: 市长行使了否决权。

normal.en: Exercise caution when crossing the road.
normal.cn: 过马路时要谨慎。

abstract.en: Picture a runner in the park at dawn.
abstract.cn: 想象黎明时在公园里跑步的人。

abstract.en: Imagine a page of questions filled in neatly.
abstract.cn: 想象一页练习被整齐地填满。

abstract.en: Think of a hand pressing a stamp of authority.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手按下代表权力的印章。

examples.en: She exercises for forty minutes each morning.
examples.cn: 她每天早上锻炼四十分钟。

examples.en: The workbook has exercises on every page.
examples.cn: 练习册每页都有练习。

examples.en: The board exercised its power to remove him.
examples.cn: 董事会行使权力免去了他的职务。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ erc（驱策）＋ ise」——把自己驱策起来动一动，就是锻炼；把权力拿出来用，就是行使。

root: 拉丁语 exercere（驱策、操练）＝ ex-（出）＋ arcere（挡住、赶动）→ exercise，核心义「把身体或权力反复用起来」。

sensesIntro.en: Exercise means physical activity, a practice task, or the use of a power or right.
sensesIntro.cn: exercise 意为身体锻炼、练习任务，或对权力、权利的行使。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a runner in the park at dawn.
core.cn: 核心意象：黎明时在公园跑步的人。

branches.en: Moving the body is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 活动身体是日常义项。

branches.en: Practice keeps a skill in shape.
branches.cn: 练习让技能保持状态。

branches.en: A right is put into action.
branches.cn: 权利被投入行动。

branches.en: Both senses repeat an action to improve.
branches.cn: 两者都通过重复动作来提升。

branches.en: Both turn something held into something used.
branches.cn: 两者都把持有之物变成使用之物。

intro.en: Exercise combines ex-, out, with Latin arcere, to drive.
intro.cn: exercise 由 ex-（出）与拉丁语 arcere（驱赶）组成。

latinIntro.en: Exercere gives French exercice and then English exercise.
latinIntro.cn: exercere 给出法语 exercice，再到英语 exercise。

items.exampleCN: arcere 也出现在 coercive 中。

exercisable 形容权利可被行使。

latinEntries.example: Exercere is the source of exercise.
latinEntries.exampleCN: exercere 是 exercise 的来源。

definition_en: a public show of objects, the act of showing a skill, or a display of feeling
core_image: 挂满画作的长廊
scene: 美术馆正在举办一场现代艺术展。The gallery is holding an exhibition of modern art.
sceneCN: 这里 exhibition 是「展览会」（第 1 个义项）；句意：美术馆正在举办一场现代艺术展。

senses.title: Public show
senses.definition: a public event where objects such as art are shown
senses.definitionCN: 公开展示艺术品等物件的活动
senses.example: The city hosts an annual photo exhibition.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市每年举办一次摄影展。
senses.why: Many objects are held out together for visitors.
senses.whyCN: 许多物件被一起举出供参观者观看。

senses.title: Show of skill
senses.definition: an act of showing a skill or ability to others
senses.definitionCN: 向他人展示技能或能力的举动
senses.example: The match was a fine exhibition of passing.
senses.exampleCN: 这场比赛是一次漂亮的传球展示。
senses.why: Ability is put on display like an object in a hall.
senses.whyCN: 能力像大厅里的展品一样被陈列出来。

senses.title: Display of feeling
senses.definition: a clear show of an emotion or quality
senses.definitionCN: 对某种情绪或特质的明显表露
senses.example: His tears were an exhibition of grief.
senses.exampleCN: 他的眼泪是悲痛的流露。
senses.why: An inner feeling is held out where others can see it.
senses.whyCN: 内心感受被展示出来让人看见。

intro.en: Exhibition comes from Latin exhibitio, a holding out.
intro.cn: exhibition 源自拉丁语 exhibitio，意为向外呈出。

items.en: Habere means to hold.
items.cn: habere 意为持有。

items.en: Exhibere means to hold out or present.
items.cn: exhibere 意为举出、呈出。

items.en: Exhibitio names the act of presenting.
items.cn: exhibitio 指呈出这一行为。

items.en: Old French exhibition keeps the public show sense.
items.cn: 古法语 exhibition 保留公开展示之意。

items.en: English exhibition extends to shows of skill and feeling.
items.cn: 英语 exhibition 扩展到技能与情感的展示。

note.en: An exhibition is the event; an exhibit is one object.
note.cn: exhibition 指整场展览，exhibit 指其中一件展品。

entries.definition: a person or firm that shows goods
a strong need to be noticed
an arrangement of things to be seen
a large public event with goods or displays

normalIntro.en: An exhibition holds many objects out for the public.
normalIntro.cn: exhibition 把许多物件举出给公众看。

normal.en: The art exhibition opens on Friday.
normal.cn: 艺术展周五开幕。

normal.en: They hold an exhibition every autumn.
normal.cn: 他们每年秋天举办展览。

normal.en: The exhibition hall was full of visitors.
normal.cn: 展览馆里挤满了参观者。

normal.en: Her paintings are on exhibition downtown.
normal.cn: 她的画正在市中心展出。

normal.en: The game was an exhibition of teamwork.
normal.cn: 这场比赛是团队合作的展示。

abstract.en: Picture a long hall hung with paintings.
abstract.cn: 想象一条挂满画作的长廊。

abstract.en: Imagine many glass cases lit in a row.
abstract.cn: 想象一排排亮着灯的玻璃柜。

abstract.en: Think of a crowd walking slowly past displays.
abstract.cn: 想象人群慢慢走过陈列品。

examples.en: The museum held an exhibition of ancient coins.
examples.cn: 博物馆举办了一场古钱币展。

examples.en: Her performance was an exhibition of great skill.
examples.cn: 她的表演是高超技艺的展示。

examples.en: The exhibition attracted visitors from abroad.
examples.cn: 这场展览吸引了海外参观者。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「exhibit（展出）＋ ion」——许多东西被摆出来给人看，就是展览会；把本领或情绪摆出来，就是展示与表露。

root: 拉丁语 exhibitio（向外呈出）来自 exhibere ＝ ex-（出）＋ habere（持有）→ exhibition，核心义「把东西集中举出给人看」。

sensesIntro.en: Exhibition means a public show of objects, a display of skill, or a show of feeling.
sensesIntro.cn: exhibition 意为公开展览、技能展示，或情感的表露。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long hall hung with paintings.
core.cn: 核心意象：挂满画作的长廊。

branches.en: The public show of objects is the main sense.
branches.cn: 公开展览物件是主要义项。

branches.en: Skill can be exhibited like art.
branches.cn: 技能可以像艺术品一样被展出。

branches.en: Feelings too are put on display.
branches.cn: 情感同样被陈列出来。

branches.en: Both put something before an audience.
branches.cn: 两者都把某物呈现在观众面前。

branches.en: The show can hold objects or emotions.
branches.cn: 展览既能承载物件，也能承载情绪。

intro.en: Exhibition combines ex-, out, with Latin habere, to hold, and -ion.
intro.cn: exhibition 由 ex-（出）、拉丁语 habere（持有）与 -ion 组成。

latinIntro.en: Exhibitio passes through French into English exhibition.
latinIntro.cn: exhibitio 经法语传入英语 exhibition。

items.exampleCN: exhibitionism 加上了表倾向的词尾。

latinEntries.example: Exhibitio is the source of exhibition.
